newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips to take 55 pct of FEI.
newsitem.headline: Philips to take 55 pct of FEI.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it was planning to take a 55 percent stake in FEI Co of Hillsboro, Oregon as part of a deal to integrate activities between the companies.
To achieve this FEI will take over most of the assets of Philips Electron Optics. In exchange Philips will acquire a stake of around 55 percent in FEI, a statement said.
The balance of the shares not acquired by Philips would remain in the hands of the current shareholders, the Dutch company said.

The combined concern would offer a wide range of products based on electron- and ion-beam technology for the biological and physical science markets as well as for the semi-conductor and components markets.

The firms expected the deal would result strengthen competitiveness and increase market share. Philips Electron Optics and FEI have for a number of years had a close relationship based on hardware and software cooperations.
FEI Company makes and designs ion beam workstations. The company in 1995 made net profit of $3.74 million on revenues of $41.70 million.
Philips Electron Optics, a leader in the electron microscope industry, is part of Philips' Industrial Electronics division with around 700 employees. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
